title: Super tour, super guide.
text: Our tour guide, Dina, was very knowledgeable and gave us a great tour. She pointed out interesting things that we would not have noticed or paid attention to on our own. We would highly recommend her as a tour guide.
author: drummax52

title: Informative and with a great guide
text: We did this tour with Eyal as our guide. We found the tour to be very informative. He has excellent knowledge of the history, and the spaces. He was able to provide context, not just us the Golden Age of Judaism in Barcelona, but also the broader history of Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain, etc.. We highly recommend this tour to anybody who is interested in this piece of history.
author: Jason R

title: Just wonderful!
text: We did the weekly Friday tour of the Jewish Quarter and Michal was a wonderful guide! We learned so much and it was a very unique experience to be able to explore the little known history of this neighborhood
author: Natalie C

title: Fantastic tour and tour guide!
text: Edo was an amazing tour guide - extremely knowledgeable as he grew up in Barcelona and also a great story teller.  He had so many interesting facts and legends that he intertwined with the general history of Barcelona as we walked around the city. All four of us (parents and two teens) greatly enjoyed our time with Edo. He was very patient, kind and flexible too throughout our four hours together. Highly recommend!
